description.text: Basic Energy cards in the Black & White design, with a ©2011 Pokémon line in the bottom left corner and no set symbol or collection number. Plain copies came in Elite Trainer Boxes. Crosshatch holo copies carry either the Play! Pokémon logo or the Pokémon League logo in the bottom right corner, and sheen holo Grass and Psychic Energy came in the Red Genesect Collection, whose deck holds eight of each.
